afterDefects: Flat grey overcast sky with no gradient. The horizon is a little washed out. The ground is a saturated cartoon green that clashes slightly with the photoreal rocks.

Flat grey overcast sky is a little dull and slightly hazy at the horizon. Small cone trees look simplistic. Otherwise richer: warm rock texture, bright greens, level sign, sand shore with posts, clearer play area.
Flat overcast grey sky with little mood and slightly hazy horizon; stylized cone-grass looks toy-like; the boulder behind the arch is an odd orange blob.
Flat grey hazy sky. The grey block tower on the right blends into the rocks. Otherwise clear and well detailed.
Grey sky is plain and slightly washed out. Grey stone block fort on the right is fairly plain. Otherwise readable, colourful and detailed, with a level sign and a clear target structure.
Flat grey overcast sky; the grey block tower at right looks untextured and plain; the enemy figure is small.
Flat grey sky. The pale block tower on the right is low in contrast. Otherwise readable.
Grey sky is a bit dull. Pale ice-like block on the right is low-contrast against the grey background. Overall brighter and better detailed.
Flat grey sky; the pale ice-like block tower looks washed out against the light background; the enemy is small.
The warm sepia sky is a little hazy and flat, but the mood is good and the warm palette is cohesive.
Warm sunset tint makes the sky slightly hazy. Otherwise strong mood, warm lighting on the rocks, readable red target tower and good colour harmony.
Warm dusk sky is a slightly flat beige gradient; the tower at right is cluttered against the rock.
The orange sunset sky is fairly flat and the rocks take on a strong orange cast. The tower blocks on the right are slightly cluttered. Still atmospheric and readable.
Orange sky is heavy and slightly hazy at the horizon. A small debris piece seems to float against the right rock. Otherwise strong sunset atmosphere and a clear target structure with pillars.
Strong orange cast tints the rocks and sky so they blend together somewhat; small enemies are hard to read against the rock; a pillar at the far right edge is cut off.
Flat grey overcast sky with slight haze at the horizon.
